title: Proteomic analysis of HEK293T cells deficient in PRDX4 protein
projectDescription: To elucidate the regulatory network of PRDX4, we identified its interacting proteins through large-scale immunoprecipitation coupled with MS-based proteomics analysis. Notably, among the identified proteins, a E3 ubiquitin ligase ARIH1 potentially involved in PRDX4 degradation was enriched, with exhibiting the strongest interaction.
sampleProcessingProtocol: All samples were subjected to on-beads complete enzymatic digestion. An appropriate amount of digestion buffer (100 mM ammonium bicarbonate) was added to the samples, followed by trypsin at a final concentration of 20 ng/μl. The samples were digested overnight. Then, dithiothreitol (DTT) was added to reach a final concentration of 5 mM, and the mixture was reduced at 37°C for 60 minutes. After that, iodoacetamide (IAA) was added to achieve a final concentration of 11 mM, and the incubation was carried out at room temperature in the dark for 45 minutes. Trypsin was added again to a final concentration of 10 ng/μl, and enzymatic digestion was continued for 4 hours. Finally, the peptides were subjected to acidification and desalting. The tryptic peptides were dissolved in solvent A, directly loaded onto a home-made reversed-phase analytical column (15-cm length, 100 μm i.d.). The mobile phase consisted of solvent A(0.1% formic acid in water) and solvent B (0.1% formic acid, 80% acetonitrile/in water). Peptides were separated with the following gradient: 0-0.5 min, 4%B; 0.5-0.6 min, 4%-7.5%B; 0.6-8.1 min, 7.5%-30%B; 8.1-9.6 min, 30%-44%B; 9.6-10 min, 44%-55%B; 10-10.5 min, 55%-99%B; 10.5-12 min, 99%B, and flow rate of 600 nl/min on a Vanquish Neo UPLC system (ThermoFisher Scientific). The peptides were subjected to capillary source followed by the timsTOF HT mass spectrometry. The electrospray voltage applied was 1.6 kV. Precursors and fragments were analyzed at the TOF detector. The timsTOF HT was operated in data independent parallel accumulation serial fragmentation (dia-PASEF) mode. The full MS scan was set as 300-1500 and 12PASEF（MS/MS mode）-MS/MS scans were acquired per cycle. The MS/MS scan range was set as 395-1080 and isolation window was set as 15 m/z.
dataProcessingProtocol: The DIA data were processed using DIA-NN search engine (v.1.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the Homo_sapiens_9606_SP_20241202.fasta (20422 entries) concatenated with reverse decoy database. Trypsin/P was specified as cleavage enzyme allowing up to 1 missing cleavages. Excision on N-term Met and carbamidomethyl on Cys were specified as fixed modification. FDR was adjusted to < 1%.
keywords: Human; e3 ubiquitin ligases; prdx4; proteomics; ubiquitination
